CheckTitle: CES alarm rules are configured and enabled
Description: Check whether each configured Cloud Eye (CES) alarm rule is enabled. The check returns no findings when the alarm inventory is empty.
Risk: Disabled alarm rules do not evaluate their configured metrics or events, which can delay detection and response to availability or security incidents.

Code.Other:
1. Log on to the Huawei Cloud console.
2. Navigate to Cloud Eye (CES).
3. Create alarm rules for the required metrics and events.
4. Ensure all alarm rules are enabled.

Recommendation.Text: Enable configured CES alarm rules so their metric or event policies are evaluated.

Notes: Reports one finding per discovered CES alarm rule using its enabled state.
